term: God (what all understand by the name, ST I q.2 a.3)
definition: The usage reported at the end of each way: 'et hoc omnes intelligunt Deum', 'quod omnes dicunt Deum', 'hoc dicimus Deum'. It reports how the name is used of the first mover, the per se necessary being, the maximal being; it is not a demonstration of divine attributes, and the only root-path result that uses it as a premise is the GOD_3 branch GOD-NAMES-DESCRIBED-FROM-USAGE (batch 4 of #1233), which reaches the naming premise only through the open bridge STMT-CALLED-GOD-IS-CLASSICAL-GOD. The problem-of-evil comparison uses the prima via instance (STMT-FIRST-UNMOVED-MOVER-IS-WHAT-ALL-UNDERSTAND-AS-GOD) to fix its own `God` predicate (`TruthCore.Comparison.ProblemOfEvil.Sig`).
note: CalledGod Calls godName x := Calls godName x, a speech community applying the name to x: GOD_3 of the DISAMB-GOD fork (batch 4 of #1233). The prima via instance remains the statement-level reading FirstUnmovedMoverIsWhatAllUnderstandAsGodReading.
